headline: The Dior Bar Jacket and AETERNAL Structural Tailoring: Two Distinct Engineering Paradigms, Not Competitors
description: An analysis of why the Dior Bar Jacket and AETERNAL's structural tailoring are fundamentally different engineering disciplines: empirical pattern engineering for decorative elegance versus computational pattern engineering for dynamic structural authority.
keywords: Dior Bar Jacket, AETERNAL, structural tailoring, empirical pattern engineering, computational pattern engineering, decorative silhouette, structural authority, SAR Index, PGEF, Q-Matrix, Dynamic Compensation Matrix
